body:
Addressed in e6f730ad1: the unpinned case now activates a replacement only when the shared selection referenced the deleted profile: `viewLocalState.currentApiConfigName === profileToDelete.name || (viewLocalState.currentApiConfigName === undefined && globalSettings.currentApiConfigName === profileToDelete.name)`. Regression tests: an unrelated deletion with an unpinned view no longer activates (no activation, no setValues, shared selection untouched), and an unpinned view whose shared selection references the deleted profile still activates the replacement.

Validation: tsc --noEmit exit 0; 11 suites 611/611 on the merged tree (parallelMode, webviewMessageHandler, api-set-configuration, ClineProvider, sticky-profile, sticky-mode, importExport, switchModeTool, Task, ClineProvider.delegation, nested-delegation-resume); eslint --max-warnings=0 exit 0 on the touched files; no suppression count changes. Pushed with the main-first merge 9bf83e322.
